title: Push-forward is a limit of smooth push-forwards by Lipschitz approximants
statement: Let lpush be any family of maps lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}), one for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, where 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) = GeometricCurrentOn univ k. Suppose lpush satisfies (PA): take N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, a Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, a sequence of maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with spt X compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and a sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N). If every F_j is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), ‖fderiv ℝ F_j x‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X, F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), and for every j there is an open W ⊇ spt X with η_j(x) = (ω(F_j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F_j x) for all x ∈ W, then X(η_j) → lpush_{N,N',k}(F, X)(ω). Conclusion: take N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, a Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with spt X compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞. Then there are C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} converging to F uniformly on ℝ^N (TendstoUniformly) such that, for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}), there are η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), each equal to F_j^#ω = (ω(F_j ·)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F_j ·) on some open set containing spt X, with X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω).
